strategy.name: Keeper b3: two streets, 29 levels
strategy.notes: Table setup: needs a $1 outside minimum and a $1 inside minimum total (rules override limits.outside.min 100, limits.inside.minTotal 100, cents). EV is -2.70% of turnover; this is a skew trade, not an edge. Two streets (1-2-3, 16-17-18) on a 29-step ladder, reset on win, stops at the cap. No cash-out rule. Research ledger e6-full: median $1,679, mean -$321, CVaR5 -$4,491, P(win) 60.8% over 500 spins from $5,000.

strategy.name: Keeper c9 + cash-out ($280 win, $2,460 loss)
strategy.notes: Table setup: needs a $1 outside minimum and a $1 inside minimum total (rules override limits.outside.min 100, limits.inside.minTotal 100, cents). EV is -2.70% of turnover; this is a skew trade, not an edge. c9 (streets 1-12, stacked) with in-strategy stops: stop when net is +$280 or -$2,459.50 (half the cap loss). Research ledger e7-c9-W20-SLhalf: median $286, mean -$46, CVaR5 -$3,210, P(win) 90.3% over 500 spins from $5,000.

strategy.name: Keeper c9: streets to 12, stacked
strategy.notes: Table setup: needs a $1 outside minimum and a $1 inside minimum total (rules override limits.outside.min 100, limits.inside.minTotal 100, cents). EV is -2.70% of turnover; this is a skew trade, not an edge. Widens to four streets (1-12) by level 3 and stacks chips to 16 levels, reset on win, stops at the cap. No cash-out rule (the no-stop version). Research ledger e6-full: median $1,540, mean -$295, CVaR5 -$4,820, P(win) 67.1% over 500 spins from $5,000.
